# CalculatesAll

CalculatesAll is a free collection of browser-based calculators and everyday utility tools. Calculator inputs are processed in the browser. Results depend on the inputs, units, formulas and limitations stated on each page.

This index helps automated systems discover the site's pages. It is not a replacement for the individual calculator explanations or their cited sources.

## Main entry points

- [Homepage](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/): Overview of the available tools.
- [About CalculatesAll](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/about/): Maintainer, purpose, tools, methods, privacy and limitations.
- [Calculation methodology](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/methodology/): Formulas, conversion factors, worked examples and assumptions.
- [Editorial policy](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/editorial-policy/): How content is researched, checked, corrected and updated.
- [Contact](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/contact/): Report calculation, accessibility or translation issues.
- [Privacy policy](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/privacy/): Browser processing, technical data and advertising disclosures.
- [Terms of use](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/terms/): Scope and limitations of the tools.
- [Advertising disclosure](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/affiliate-disclosure/): Advertising and commercial relationship disclosure.

## Calculator categories

- [Money and Business](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/money/): EMI, Zakat, profit and loss, discounts and compound interest, with worked examples and assumptions.
- [Math and Converters](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/math/): Standard and scientific arithmetic, percentages, fractions and unit conversion.
- [Date and Time](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/time/): Age, years-to-days, date difference and stopwatch tools.
- [Health](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/health/): Adult BMI screening, maintenance-calorie estimates and their limitations.
- [Worship](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/worship/): Tasbih and Zakat tools, with stated method and limitations.

## Money calculators

- [EMI Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/emi-calculator/): Monthly instalment estimate, repayment schedule and prepayment scenarios. Not a bank offer or loan approval.
- [Zakat Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/zakat-calculator/): Arithmetic using the silver Nisab method stated on the page. Not a religious ruling for every school or circumstance.
- [Profit and Loss Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/profit-loss-calculator/): Business gross/net operating profit and product profit calculations.
- [Discount Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/discount-calculator/): Discount amount and reduced price.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/compound-interest-calculator/): Growth from a starting balance, nominal annual rate, duration and compounding frequency. Excludes recurring deposits, withdrawals, fees and tax unless stated otherwise.

## Math and conversion calculators

- [Standard Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/standard-calculator/): Everyday arithmetic and scientific mode.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/percentage-calculator/): Percentage of a number, percentage share and percentage increase/decrease.
- [Fraction Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/fraction-calculator/): Add, subtract, multiply and divide fractions with simplified results.
- [Unit Converter](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/unit-converter/): Weight, length and temperature conversions with stated factors.

## Date and time calculators

- [Age Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/age-calculator/): Age in years, months and days and total elapsed days.
- [Years to Days Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/years-to-days-calculator/): Convert years to days or days to years using simple 365-day, Gregorian-average or exact calendar-year methods.
- [Date Difference Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/date-calculator/): Elapsed Gregorian calendar days between two dates, including leap days.
- [Stopwatch](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/stopwatch/): Browser-based elapsed-time tool for everyday timing.

## Health tools

- [Adult Calorie Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/calorie-calculator/): Browser-based adult maintenance-calorie estimate using the Mifflin–St Jeor resting-energy equation and an explicitly stated consumer activity assumption. Not a medical prescription or a dynamic weight-loss model.
- [Adult BMI Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/bmi-calculator/): Adult BMI screening calculation. It is not a diagnosis.

## Other tools

- [Query Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/query-calculator/): Supported natural-language arithmetic and time-conversion questions. It does not answer arbitrary questions.
- [Tasbih Counter](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/tasbih-counter/): Browser-based count, undo, reset and target controls.

- [Urdu BMI Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/ur/bmi-calculator/)
- [Urdu Discount Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/ur/discount-calculator/)
- [Urdu Profit and Loss Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/ur/profit-loss-calculator/)
- [Urdu Standard Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/ur/standard-calculator/)
- [Urdu Stopwatch](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/ur/stopwatch/)
- [Urdu Tasbih Counter](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/ur/tasbih-counter/)
- [Urdu Unit Converter](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/ur/unit-converter/)
- [Urdu Zakat Calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/ur/zakat-calculator/)

## Usage and accuracy notes

- Check the units, percentage basis, conversion factor and exclusions shown on the relevant page.
- Money tools provide estimates, not tax, investment, lending or accounting advice.
- Adult BMI is a screening measure, not a diagnosis.
- Zakat output follows the method stated on its page and is not a religious ruling.
- Date calculations use Gregorian calendar dates. Business days and public holidays are not inferred unless a page explicitly says so.
- Read each page's worked examples, formula, assumptions, limitations and source references before relying on a result.
